purpose: Teach: 閉会/ゲン/ヘルス/賜り/設問/緊密/同点/勧める

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 年末の閉会式、社員代表、誰に、お願いしましょうか、本当に、慎重に、選びましょうね、皆、頑張った一年、本当に、感謝、しないと、本当に、いけませんね。
lines.en: For the year-end closing ceremony, we need to think carefully about who we ask to represent the staff. It's been such a hardworking year — we really do need to show our gratitude properly.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Slightly formal register befitting a workplace address. Deliberate pacing on key words like 'carefully' and 'gratitude.' Warm underlying tone — she means this. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商談前の、ゲン担ぎ、私も、最近、するようになっちゃいました、本当に、効果あるかも、しれませんよね、お客様、本当に、好評、続いておりますし。
lines.en: Yes. I've actually started doing pre-deal rituals myself lately, and you know, I think they might actually be working. Our customers have been responding really well to it.
lines.style: Relaxed, almost conversational. A small smile in the voice — he's admitting something slightly superstitious and comfortable with it. Warm agreement. Measured pace, leaning slightly into the shared observation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員のヘルス管理、本気で、強化しないと、いけないわね、健康第一の、企業文化、本当に、目指したいわよね、私たち、リーダーとして、絶対に、頼みますよ、皆。
lines.en: We really do need to get serious about our staff health and wellness programs. I want us to build a workplace culture where health comes first — that's what I'm asking you all to help me create as leaders.
lines.style: Shift to firmer conviction. Direct eye-contact tone. Slower, more deliberate pacing on 'serious' and 'health comes first.' Not commanding, but purposeful. She's asking them to step up with her.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業以来、お客様からの、お声、賜り、社員、本当に、励みに、しております、感謝の気持ち、絶対、忘れずに、業務、取り組んでまいります、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Since we founded this company, our customers have given us their trust and feedback, and that encourages all our staff. We'll never forget that gratitude, and we'll keep bringing that appreciation into every piece of work we do.
lines.style: Formal, sincere register. Respectful pace — he's honoring what he's saying. No rush. Quiet dignity in the delivery. The kind of statement he's thought through and believes completely.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 試験の設問、毎年、内容、改善していかないとね、若手の感性、本当に、活かして、より、現代的な、内容、目指したいわよね、本当に、絶対、楽しみよ、これから。
lines.en: The test questions we use every year — we need to keep improving them. I want us to tap into the fresh perspective our younger staff bring, and create something that really feels current and relevant. I'm genuinely excited to see where this goes.
lines.style: Energized but controlled. She's leaning forward slightly in her tone. Quick pace on 'improve' and 'fresh.' Genuine warmth building toward the end. The voice of someone who believes in her team's potential.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各部署と、緊密に、連携しております、社内、本当に、風通し、よくなってきましたよね、最近、特に、コミュニケーション、活性化、感じております、本当に、嬉しいです。
lines.en: Yes. We're working closely with each department, and I have to say, the atmosphere in the office has really improved lately. Communication is much more active now — it's been genuinely good to see.
lines.style: Warm observation. Conversational but grounded. He's noticing something real and pleased about it. Gentle pride in his voice. Steady pace, no performance — just honest reflection.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合と、本当に、同点で、競っているわよね、当社、ここからが、勝負ですよ、皆、本気で、頑張りましょうね、絶対に、勝ちますよ、私たち、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We're tied with our competitors right now, and this is where it matters. Everyone, we need to give this everything we've got. We will win this — I know we will.
lines.style: Sudden shift to rally-cry energy. Crisp attack on 'tied' and 'matters.' Builds conviction through the line. Not aggressive, but determined and focused. She's giving them permission to believe they can.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様に、新商品、自信を持って、勧めるようにしてまいります、本当に、絶対、ご納得、いただけると、信じております、社員、皆、頑張ります、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure to introduce our new products to our valued customers with real confidence. I truly believe they'll be satisfied with what we're offering, and our entire team is ready to make that happen.
lines.style: Professional closing statement. Measured, affirming tone. Slight lift at 'confidence' and 'truly believe' — he's conveying genuine faith. Calm authority. The kind of wrap-up that settles things with conviction.
